SELECT b.block_id, b.block_type, b.block_value, b.reason, b.blocked_by, b.blocked_at, b.expires_at, b.is_active, ua.nickname AS blocked_by_nickname, ut.nickname AS target_nickname FROM ADMIN_ASSISTANT_BLOCK b LEFT JOIN USERS ua ON ua.user_idx = b.blocked_by LEFT JOIN USERS ut ON b.block_type = 'USER' AND ut.user_idx = CAST(b.block_value AS UNSIGNED)
WHERE b.is_active = 1
ORDER BY b.blocked_at DESC

SELECT block_id, block_type, block_value, reason, blocked_by, blocked_at, expires_at, is_active FROM ADMIN_ASSISTANT_BLOCK WHERE is_active = 1 AND block_type = #{blockType} AND block_value = #{blockValue} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_ASSISTANT_BLOCK (block_type, block_value, reason, blocked_by, blocked_at, expires_at, is_active) VALUES (#{blockType}, #{blockValue}, #{reason}, #{blockedBy}, NOW(), #{expiresAt}, 1)
